properties.answer: "Start from the next release." — Anthony, 2026-07-25, on whether the nine shipped releases should be corrected to record that they included documentation. The past release record is left exactly as it stands. Retro-editing nine Release nodes to claim a contents-line nobody wrote at the time would be reconstructing history rather than recording it, and dec:intent-preserved is specifically about not doing that — the releases genuinely did ship a README and a setup guide, but the design did not model documentation as a deliverable until 2026-07-25, and that is a true fact about when the understanding arrived. The obligation is forward: the next release cut must include cmp:docs in its contents.
properties.context_setter: “docs” is built but ships in nothing
properties.question: You've just said documentation is part of reflow2, like documentation shipped with a fighter jet. The graph now takes that literally and points out that none of your nine releases lists documentation as something it delivered — even though every one of them shipped a README and a setup guide. Should the past releases be corrected to say they included the documentation, or should this start from the next release onward?
